changes: Add a bounded local TURN/UDP proxy that drops and reorders encrypted application-epoch packets after channels open.
Exercise reliable ordered/unordered delivery under packet impairment, zero retransmissions and 100 ms lifetime through a three-second blackout.
Observe ten quiet seconds after fresh messages arrive to reject late old messages.
Fill four 256 KiB channel queues and verify the shared 1 MiB limit rejects a send on an empty fifth channel, then delivers its exact retry once.
Treat a correlated SessionClosed reply to close as a remote cleanup acknowledgement, while still waiting for native closure. Force that race in every accepted case.
Open, send and close through the actual C++ calls and serialized public Blueprint nodes; verify each channel and final peer cleanup.

cleanup.adb_reverse_cleanup_note: Three ports appeared after the initial baseline. None was allocated by this run; they were left untouched.

client.error: Unexpected operation failure or fabricated channel.

engine_checkout_note: Per-build revisions and existing checkout changes are recorded. This is local package validation, not clean-host reproduction.
limitations: Physical iOS acceptance remains deferred; iOS runs use ARM64 simulators.
Controlled local TURN/UDP traffic only. No Internet NAT, Wi-Fi/cellular handover, ICE restart, screen lock or forced process-termination acceptance.
Expiry covers SCTP MaxLifetime=100 ms and MaxRetransmits=0; the separate 30-second plugin send-queue deadline is not tested here.
The proxy sees encrypted packets, including SCTP control traffic, not individual SCTP messages. Unordered application delivery need not arrive out of order.
DTLS 1.3 fixture classification targets initial application epoch 3 without connection IDs or key updates, as used by these bounded runs.
Development package sizes are absolute sizes, not Shipping download sizes or measured RTC deltas.

repaired_attempts: The first Direct Android package contained an earlier quiet-window assertion. It was rejected and the Direct packages were rebuilt from final sources.

The initial UDP classifier recognized legacy DTLS only. The accepted classifier also recognizes the pinned BoringSSL DTLS 1.3 epoch-3 unified header, with CID and handshake-epoch rejection tests. Zero-impairment results were not accepted.
A Full Android run was interrupted when USB disconnected. Its private files were removed after reconnect; the full suite was rerun in a fresh directory.

A Direct-only simulator run exposed a Disconnect failure after all messages and channel closes succeeded. A deterministic authenticated close-before-close fixture reproduced it on the old package. The client now acknowledges SessionClosed only for its correlated close request; every accepted case forces that race.
A recook required refreshed per-project Editor module metadata after the shared Editor build ID changed. The final Server and mobile profiles were rebuilt with their Editor modules before cooking.
Two UBT startups raced while rotating Trace.uba before acquiring the build mutex. Build startups were serialized; the corrected Direct rebuild passed.
